title: TenantExportManifest
description: manifest.json inside a tenant export ZIP (kind=tenant_export, schema_version=1). The ZIP also contains files/<stored_file_id> for every attachment. Produced by GET /api/v1/t/{tenant_id}/export, consumed by POST /api/v1/admin/tenants/import. On import every primary key is re-issued and all foreign keys (including tenant_id) are remapped; asset references ({asset_id, version}) are kept as-is.

tables.description: Tenant-scoped table name -> rows, in foreign-key dependency order. Includes audit_logs of the tenant. Datetimes are ISO-8601 strings; JSON columns are embedded as JSON.
